relationships.subject: bevacizumab
relationships.evidence_quote: bevacizumab, a monoclonal antibody against VEGF

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: it has been associated with tumor angiogenesis and progression of GCTs

key_findings: Serum VEGF decreased after surgery and chemotherapy and rose again with disease progression in two granulosa cell tumor cases.
VEGF was strongly expressed in tumor cells by immunohistochemistry in 10 GCT cases.
